# Goo interaction regression fixture

This source bag is deliberately outside `extras/mounts`. Only the application
compatibility runner adds it to a disposable catalogue. It exercises selection,
editing, action capture, lifetime replacement and Mash topologies through real
Grove compilation and production HTTP/assets.

Run `python3 extras/mounts/explorer/scripts/check-integration.py` with the locked
WISP runtime. `goo-inspector` is the production consumer; this is a test specimen.
